normalized_facts.advisory: FCC blocks programmatic access to the National Broadband Map AND its lat/lng → location_id lookup, so the only honest path is: open the FCC NBM search page, paste the parcel address (or lat/lng), and the viewer will return the official Location Summary — every fixed broadband provider + advertised speeds the FCC has on file. For office / life-science / data-center deals where broadband is a hard underwriting factor, also email the carriers directly to confirm building service + actual delivered speeds.
